summary: CRITICAL: Workflow fails to meet core requirement — instructions mandate ALL tests run via act with act-result.txt artifact containing validation against exact expected values per test case. Provided workflow has test job that runs bats but: (1) does not capture output to act-result.txt, (2) does not structure multi-case harness with fixture data, (3) does not assert exact output values. Script itself is excellent (5/5: proper shebang, set -euo, validation, error handling, clear jq logic). Workflow structure is sound (test→cleanup→report chain, proper permissions) but missing critical act integration framework entirely. Lines 31-43: dependency install has minor redundancy but acceptable. Missing: act output capture/validation logic that requirements explicitly demand.
